From the menu

A menu for sharing: dips and salads, plates for the table, meat from the grill and desserts. Meze for two or more. Prices at the restaurant.

Appetisers and salads

  • Tahini, tzatziki, hummus and village yogurt
  • Spicy feta dip and eggplant dip
  • Beets, green olives, pickled vegetables and feta
  • Village salad, Greek salad and dakos salad

For sharing

  • Fried halloumi sticks with seasonal jam
  • Fried feta with honey and pomegranate
  • Crispy zucchini with yogurt dip, zucchini balls
  • Mushrooms, sautéed with red wine or grilled
  • Pomilorotigania: fried tomato with egg and feta
  • Arugula with spinach and eggs
  • Cypriot pilaf, ravioli and the Tatsia signature pasta

Meat dishes

  • Afelia
  • Sautéed chicken liver in honey and commandaria
  • Cyprus meatballs
  • Pork or chicken souvlaki, sheftalia
  • Cypriot sausage and pastourmas
  • Pork belly, lamb ribs, pork chop and chicken thigh from the grill

Meze and dessert

  • Meze for the whole table, for two or more
  • Chocolate pie with vanilla ice cream

At Tatsia

Photos from the restaurant’s Google listing.

Plates for the middle of the table

Tatsia is a meze restaurant at Chrystodoulou Iakovidi 33 in Larnaca, with a dining room around a small stage and a courtyard. The menu is made for sharing: dips and salads, fried halloumi with seasonal jam, fried feta with honey and pomegranate, chicken liver in honey and commandaria, souvlaki and sheftalia, and desserts such as chocolate pie with ice cream. There is live music on Thursday, Friday and Saturday. In the reviews guests mention the music, the polite staff and the generous plates.

Today Tatsia has no website of its own: the Google listing only links to Facebook. Checked on 23 September 2026.

What guests say

From the Google listing, 4.8 stars on average across 246 reviews.

“Επισκεφθήκαμε την ταβέρνα την 1/10 μεσημέρι. Το προσωπικό ήταν ευγενέστατο, πρόθυμο να εξυπηρετήσει και με χαμόγελο σε κάθε στιγμή. Η ατμόσφαιρα ζεστή και φιλική, ενώ οι μουσικοί ήταν πάρα πολύ καλοί. Σίγουρα θα ξαναπάμε!”

Translation: “We visited the tavern on 1/10 at lunchtime. The staff were extremely polite, willing to help and smiling at every moment. The atmosphere was warm and friendly, and the musicians were very, very good. We will definitely go again!”

Google review
“Ωραία ατμόσφαιρα. Εύγευστο και αρκετό φαγητό για τους καλοφαγάδες. Δοκιμάστε τη ζεστή σοκολατόπιτα με παγωτό μαστίχα. Φανταστική. Πολύ ωραία έντεχνη μουσική. Επειδή δεν είμαι λάτρης της ταβέρνας και δύσκολα δίνω τα εύσημα η "Τατσιά" με κέρδισε και σίγουρα θα ξαναπάω. Είναι από τις σπάνιες φορές που απόλαυσα ψηλού επιπέδου ταβέρνα. Σας την προτείνω με χίλια.”

Translation: “Nice atmosphere. Tasty food, and plenty of it for good eaters. Try the warm chocolate pie with mastic ice cream. Fantastic. Very nice éntechno music. As I am not a tavern lover and rarely give praise, Tatsia won me over and I will definitely go again. It is one of the rare times I have enjoyed a tavern of such a high level. I recommend it a thousand times.”

Google review
“Κατι διαφορετικο χαλλουμι τραγανο με μαρμελαδα συκου και συκοτακι με μελι και κουμανταρια ηταν φανταστικα αλλα και τα υπολοιπα ολα πολυ ωδαια και πολυ καλη εξηπηρετηση”

Translation: “Something different: crispy halloumi with fig jam and liver with honey and commandaria were fantastic, but everything else was also very nice, and very good service.”

Google review
“Καταπληκτικό φαγητό οτι καλύτερο δοκιμάσαμε σε ταβέρνα πολύ εξυπηρετικο προσωπικό σε μια πανέμορφη αυλή”
